'''Blaze''' is a [[mod]] that increases the damage and {{D|Heat}} damage for [[:Category:Shotgun|shotguns]] by 15% per rank, at a maximum of 60% at rank 3.

==Stats==

|}

==Drop Locations==
Blaze drops from [[Nightmare Mode]] missions. Blaze only drops from Tier 1 (easy) missions, which are on Earth, Venus, Mercury, and Mars.{{DropLocations}}

==Notes==
*This mod, when combined with {{M|Point Blank}} and {{M|Vicious Spread}} adds up to a total damage increase of +240%.
**Using {{M|Primed Point Blank}} instead of Point Blank will result in a total damage increase of +315%
*This mod is more cost effective than a Rank 3 Point Blank mod and a rank 3 {{M|Incendiary Coat}} mod put together (9 mod capacity compared to 16).
*The +60% base damage will apply to the +60% heat damage, giving approximately +96% heat damage.

==Notes==
*The +120% Critical Damage buff applies '''additively''' with other Critical Damage mods. Meaning, a base 2x crit multiplier with maxed {{M|Vital Sense}}, {{M|Hammer Shot}} and Bladed Rounds will become 8.0x.
*Upon killing an enemy, a {{Stat|Critical Multiplier}} buff icon and timer will appear next to the player's health.
*For projectiles with travel time, this mod is unaffected by whether you were aiming when the shot was fired; the {{Stat|Critical Multiplier}} increase will apply as long as you are aiming when the projectile hits.

==Tips==
*This mod is ideal for use on weapons with high base critical chances, ex. {{Weapon|Soma}}, {{Weapon|Vectis}}, {{Weapon|Amprex}}, {{Weapon|Tonkor}}, etc.

{{Codex|Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.}}
The '''Baza''' is a  {{Faction|Tenno}} [[Noise Level|silenced]] submachine gun with a high [[critical chance]], [[critical multiplier]], [[fire rate]] and  [[accuracy]] at the cost medium range damage falloff and a small magazine.

==Characteristics==
* This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*This weapon is [[Noise Level|Silent]].
*Low [[zoom]] when aiming.
*Shorter damage falloff distance for a hit-scan weapon.
{{Advantages|
*Very high [[accuracy]] per shot, even at full auto.
*Negligible recoil.
*[[Noise Level|Silent]] nature allows for stealth usage.
*Lower zoom allows for a more stable view.}}
{{Disadvantages|
*Has linear damage falloff from 100% to 50% starting at 22m until 34m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]).
**Cannot equip {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.
*Poor ammo economy.
}}
{{WeaponComparison|Baza Prime}}

==Acquisition==
The Baza's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Tenno Lab|Tenno Lab]] in the [[dojo]].
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*The weapon's firing sounds increases in pitch when 15 or fewer rounds are remaining in the magazine, indicating that the weapon's magazine is almost empty.
*The weapon has minimal zoom when aiming, helpful for mods that add bonuses while aiming like {{M|Argon Scope}}.

==Tips==
*The Baza's high accuracy allows it to land headshots consistently compared to other automatic weapons, which along with its good critical hit chance makes it ideal for builds using {{M|Argon Scope}}.
*Its lower [[status chance]] compared to some other automatic rifles can be alleviated with the {{M|Hunter Munitions}} mod, allowing the weapon to spread {{D|Slash}} procs rapidly to enemies, which helps the weapon a lot versus heavy armor.
*Its silenced nature makes it synergize well with {{WF|Ivara}}, as firing the weapon will not interrupt her {{A|Prowl}} ability.
*Since the Baza has very high accuracy, it can use [[Heavy Caliber]] with almost no drawback and increasing the weapon's overall damage output.

==Trivia==
*The ''[[wikipedia:Aviceda|Baza]]'' are a genus of bird of prey in the Accipitridae family.
*Physically, the weapon bears a strong resemblance to the real-life [[wikipedia:PP-19_Bizon|PP-19 Bizon]] SMG, due to Baza's underbarrel, horizontal magazine, and its overall appearance.
**The name Baza may be derived from the PP-19's nickname, Bizon.
*The name Baza (shortening of "Barry") is strongly believe to be derived from a conversation had at PAX Aus between DE staff and fans, where "Australian Names" were discussed. It was claimed that "Baza" may be the "most Australian name".  There was also discussion about many great names from native flora and fauna (released with the {{Weapon|Cassowar}}).
*Tied with {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, {{Weapon|Attica}}, and {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the highest [[critical multiplier]] of all fully automatic rifles.
*Second fastest [[reload speed]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Baza Prime}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the third fastest [[fire rate]] of all fully automatic rifles, behind {{Weapon|Grakata}} and {{Weapon|Prisma Grakata}}.
*Tied with {{Weapon|Baza Prime}} for the fourth lowest base damage of all fully automatic rifles, after {{Weapon|Prisma Grakata}}, {{Weapon|Soma}}/{{Weapon|Soma Prime}}, and {{Weapon|Grakata}}; very reliant on its high critical damage potential.

'''Boar Incarnon Genesis''' is an item that is used to add [[Incarnon]] upgrades to the {{Weapon|Boar}} or {{Weapon|Boar Prime}}.

==Acquisition==
*Upon completion of [[The Duviri Paradox]] and [[Angels of the Zariman]], and unlocking [[The Steel Path]], players can earn {{Resource|Boar Incarnon Genesis}} from [[The Circuit]]'s Steel Path to place on their Boar with the help of [[Cavalero]] in the [[Chrysalith]]. This [[Incarnon Genesis]] form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
*Purchased from Cavalero for {{pc|120}}, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made '''once'''.

==Incarnon Genesis==

*Installing the Boar Incarnon Genesis requires 20 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}, 60 {{Resource|Rune Marrow}}, and 60 {{Resource|Tasoma Extract}}.
*When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 [[affinity]] to the weapon, affected by [[Affinity Booster]]s.

===Overview===
*Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving [[Enemy Body Parts|weakpoint hits]] and then pressing the [[Alternate Fire]] button. '''50''' weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
**Charges '''do''' generate when hitting weak points highlighted by {{A|Sonar}} or {{M|Detect Vulnerability}}. 
***However, they do not generate from hits on {{A|Crystallize}}'s crystalline growths.
**Weakpoints on corpses or [[Invulnerable]] targets do '''not''' build charges.
**Individual [[Multishot]] bullets can build charges.
*Mode switching is '''not''' instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's [[reload speed]].
*Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
*Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Boar's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing '''3''' rounds to a maximum of '''150'''. Once all ammunition is expended, the Boar reverts to its normal form.
**Incarnon Form's magazine is '''not''' affected by mods.
**Incarnon Form is '''not''' affected by [[Ammo Efficiency]] (such as {{A|Energized Munitions}}).
**Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, [[bleedout]], or being [[disarm]]ed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon [[death]].
